MU.note: Micron's fiscal year ends on the Thursday closest to 31 August (FY2020 ended 2020-09-03, FY2025 ended 2025-08-28). FY2020-FY2025 runs from a mid-cycle year to an early AI-upcycle year; memory revenue is highly cyclical (FY2023 fell 49%). On the latest five fiscal years (FY2021-FY2026, FY2026 ended 2026-09-03) the CAGR is 36.9%, driven by the 2026 HBM/DRAM price spike.

ASML.note: Constant currency (EUR, reporting currency; US GAAP 20-F net sales).

VST.note: Total revenues including hedging/derivative results. Growth is partly inorganic: Energy Harbor (nuclear + retail, closed 2024-03-01) added ~4 GW of nuclear; FY2021 includes Winter Storm Uri.

usd.note: translated at the BCB PTAX year-end rates (5.1967 BRL/USD on 2020-12-31, 5.5024 on 2025-12-31), so it mixes FX moves

ABEV.note: Constant currency (BRL, reporting currency; IFRS 20-F net revenue). Includes Argentina (Quilmes) under IAS 29 hyperinflation accounting, which inflates nominal growth in some years.

UBER.note: FY2020 revenue was COVID-depressed (Mobility gross bookings fell ~46% in 2020 while Delivery surged), so the 5y CAGR overstates the run-rate; it also reflects accounting changes (UK/business-model shifts to principal reporting from 2022 raised revenue vs gross bookings) and the Postmates (2020) and Transplace (2021, Freight) acquisitions.

BE.note: Total revenue (product, installation, service, electricity). FY2025 includes the first large AI data-center deployments (AEP, Oracle, Equinix) and Korea (SK ecoplant) volumes; Korea shipments are lumpy year to year.

AVGO.note: Broadcom fiscal years end on the Sunday closest to 31 October (FY2020 ended 2020-11-01, FY2025 on 2025-11-02). Growth is partly inorganic: VMware (closed 2023-11-22, ~$69B) added ~$13-14B of annual infrastructure-software revenue from FY2024; FY2025 also reflects the AI ASIC/networking ramp. Organic semiconductor growth is lower than the headline CAGR.

VIST.note: Reported in USD (IFRS, USD functional currency). FY2020 was COVID-depressed (Brent ~$42, Vaca Muerta activity halted in Q2-2020); growth is mostly organic shale ramp-up, but FY2025 is partly inorganic: Vista acquired Petronas' 50% of La Amarga Chica (LLL) in Apr-2025, adding ~40k boe/d gross. Revenue also moves with Brent.

usd.note: USD convenience translations from each 20-F (year-end NT$/US$ rate), so they mix FX moves

TSM.note: Constant currency (TWD, reporting currency; IFRS net revenue). FY2020-FY2025 is almost entirely organic, driven by HPC/AI accelerators (N5/N3, CoWoS); FY2023 dipped on the smartphone/PC inventory correction.

SPCX.definition: Total revenue as reported (recast to include xAI and X Holdings under common control)
SPCX.source: SpaceX IPO prospectus (Form 424B4 filed 2026-06-12, accession 0001628280-26-042639), consolidated statements of operations
SPCX.shortNote: SpaceX IPO'd on 2026-06-12 and the prospectus only contains audited FY2023-FY2025; FY2021-FY2022 are not disclosed, so the longest available window (2 years) is used
SPCX.note: Only FY2023-FY2025 are available (2 compounding periods, not 5). Figures are recast for the common-control mergers with xAI (Feb-2026) and X Holdings (Mar-2025), so X/Twitter advertising is included in every year; Cursor (Aug-2026) is not. Segment CAGRs FY2023-25: Space 7.2%, Connectivity (Starlink) 71.6%, AI 4.0% (X advertising fell). Latest TTM (to 2026-09-30): $32.0B (Q3 2026 8-K); Q3 2026 revenue alone was $14.6B, +161% y/y.
